<kestrel> i finally automated my morning routine
<kestrel> the script makes coffee, reads my email and updates my status
<pebble> nice, so what do you do now?
<kestrel> watch the logs to make sure it's having a good day

<marlowe> who named the production database "test"?
<juniper> past me
<juniper> past me was very optimistic

<ozzie> the build is green!
<ozzie> wait, no, that's the colourblind theme

Any sufficiently old TODO comment is indistinguishable from documentation.
- a tired maintainer

<tamsin> how many developers does it take to change a lightbulb?
<rook> none, that's a hardware problem
<tamsin> how many hardware engineers then?
<rook> they'll fix it in software

<pebble> my code worked first time
<marlowe> screenshot it, nobody will believe you
<pebble> i would but the screenshot tool is broken

<juniper> i've been staring at this bug for three hours
<rook> have you tried explaining it to the rubber duck?
<juniper> the duck has asked to be reassigned

<kestrel> i deleted 400 lines of code today
<tamsin> what did they do?
<kestrel> no idea, and now nobody ever will

<ozzie> brb, restarting my router
<ozzie> ok i'm back
<pebble> you were gone for 40 minutes
<ozzie> it was a big router
